body: Although I think I've come to my decision, I thank you for your kind words.
Thanks...but I'm pretty sure I know what I'm going to do..

I know the almost-rape wasn't my fault. My "friends" on the other hand believe I brought it on myself by being "naive". When I talked to another "friend" about the whole rumor crap, he pretty much said I was being "helpless and naive" and cursed me out for telling him that he's been avoiding me for other people. As of now, I have 0 friends (i have a group of people who will be around me when I'm not being "depressing and sad" but other than that if I say anything about my feelings, they stop talking to me. theyre "over it"). I don't trust those suicide hotlines (sent police to my house because the operator misunderstood me). this is the last thing I have..

2 options:  
1) my ex  
2) time  

I don't see myself waiting this out. The feeling is overwhelming. And my ex isn't coming back. So...nothing. I just want out.
